description: Behavioral mutation checks for PresetInstalledFilaments public contracts.

mutants.description: Invert the public fallback gate. The no-installed-section row must add the model default, while the compatible-installed row must suppress it; both persisted AppConfig and final visibility expose the wrong branch.

Persist discovered default materials as an empty AppConfig value. AppConfig keeps the key present, but Preset::set_visible_from_appconfig treats only nonempty values as installed; the test checks both the canonical saved value and resulting visibility.
